name: Alert
scaffolding_intent: Displays exclamation mark sprites above an entity involved in the key event of the scene, signaling that something important is happening there

parameters.name: color
parameters.description: Fill color of the exclamation marks

parameters.name: scale
parameters.description: Size multiplier for the alert marks

correction_intent: Child described the key event of the scene wrongly, or stated that nothing is happening when the scene shows a problem or surprise (a theft, a fall, a threat, a discovery). Target the entity at the center of the actual event. Do NOT use for a wrong action of a single entity; that is A1 or A2.
suggestion_intent: The scene contains a problem, surprise, or turning point (the initiating event) that the child has not mentioned, or a character visibly reacting to it whose reaction the child has not described. Target the entity involved in the event. Requires a clearly depicted event, not routine activity.
